* * *

From the desk of: Pejman Ghadimi
Author, Third Circle Theory

I’ve been an entrepreneur for 20+ years now.
With over $100 million dollars in revenue generated through my online education platforms (Watch Trading Academy, Exotic Car Hacks, Secret Academy), consulting businesses, and various investment funds.
Now here’s the deal…
During this time I’ve seen thousands of people try to start their own business or side hustle.
Want to know how many end up succeeding?
1%.
And it doesn’t take a rocket scientist to figure this out either.

Image: TJS09617-Edit

Just look around you.
The majority of people are NOT successful entrepreneurs.
Unless you call sitting at a Starbucks for 2+ hours with your MacBook watching motivational videos “being an entrepreneur."

I’ve interviewed more than 400 millionaires (and billionaires) in over 75 industries.

There’s one common factor that separates them from everyone else.
And it has nothing to do with having enough money, market saturation, or being lucky.
The #1 differentiator between those who are successful and those who aren’t is:

Mindset.
That’s it.
The way you think.
Your thoughts become your actions.
And your actions dictate your results.
But this isn’t about typical “woo woo” guru crap you see being shouted everywhere:

“Work harder than your competition”
“Follow your passion.”
“If you want it bad enough, you’ll make it happen.”

It’s not that simple.
Since the day you were born, your mind has been conditioned to believe whatever worldview you were taught to believe.
And it takes a special approach to change the way you think so it’s rewired for success.
Which is why I’m so excited to share my best-selling book with you, Third Circle Theory.

With Over 750,000 Copies Sold...People Are Calling Third Circle Theory The "Think And Grow Rich Of The 21st Century"

* * *

Image: cfehr

Third Circle Theory is unlike anything you have ever read before.

Bold claim, I know.

But trust me.

There's nothing else like this out there.

98% of books on entrepreneurship are full of fluff.

They give you surface-level information on how to do customer research, create products, and build a brand. 

Maybe they'll graze over mindset stuff and tell you the secret to success is to "believe in yourself."

But they don't dive deep into the psyche of a successful entrepreneur.

Third Circle Theory gives you a 360 degree guide to understanding how humans progress through business and life.

It will instantly rewire the way you think, while helping you progress through each stage to ultimately reach what I call "Mastery of Life."

Image: cfehr

The book is based on my very own personal experiences plus the conversations I've had with 400+ millionaire and billionaire entrepreneurs.

Third Circle Theory is written in a way to be self-reflective.

Warning: Third Circle Theory WILL make you uncomfortable. It'll force you to look deep within yourself and question reality itself. If you're not prepared to face the truth, then please don't buy this book.

But here's the good news.

It's a quick read.

At around 200 pages, you can read it in a day if you focus.
